summary: Phase-2 VISUAL redesign frontend E2E verified. MY TABLE screen (/my-table): page renders with photoreal room preview, felt-swatches recolor the oval (emerald rgb(15,81,50) and purple rgb(61,26,91) applied on click), all 7 tabs switch content and non-table tabs expose mytable-options-<tab>, detail-pills visible, Apply Free Theme shows toast 'Theme applied — free! / Cosmetics never affect gameplay.', selection persists to localStorage (royal11_cosmetics + royal11_rummy_theme=luxury) across reload, daily-bonus-widget present, subtitle reads 'All themes are FREE · Cosmetics never affect gameplay'. AAA RUMMY TABLE (Practice Points Rummy via Games nav → casino-game-rummy_points → rummy-quick-play): vegas-palace has vegas-palace--aaa class, rummy-backwall reads 'POINTS RUMMY', vegas-host renders (@1920 width), rummy-room-code shows '#CB7BCA5' (# + 7 chars), rummy-info-btn opens rummy-info-modal and rummy-info-close dismisses it, rummy-fullscreen-btn present, rummy-rewards-btn opens the Refer&Earn 200 Coins modal (refer-heading 'Refer & Earn 200 Coins'), emoji-only-badge visible bottom-right, daily-bonus-widget visible bottom-left, playing-card-back (V2) renders in draw pile. Cosmetic decoupling verified: applying purple felt then entering practice rummy caused no errors and gameplay UI is unchanged. Regression: /wallet, /casino, /my-table load with 0 page errors and 0 console errors.

aaa_rummy_table.rummy_discard_and_declare: CONDITIONAL - not rendered when round phase is SETTLED/between-rounds (practice bot auto-plays round on entry). Buttons render only when myTurn && drawDone, per code (RummyTable.jsx L403/L405). Expected behavior consistent with iter36 notes; testids exist in source.

cosmetic_decoupling.apply_felt_then_enter_rummy: PASS — no console/page errors, gameplay controls unchanged
cosmetic_decoupling.cosmetics_never_sent_to_engine: Confirmed in code (MyTable.jsx writes only to localStorage; no API call)

critical_code_review_comments: MyTable persists cosmetics per-browser (localStorage), not per-user account. Two users on the same device will overwrite each other's picks. Acceptable for phase-2 visual pass but consider namespacing by user id later.

rummy-discard / rummy-declare testids only exist inside the active-round branch (myTurn && !SETTLED). On practice tables the bot round auto-settles fast, so E2E tests need to either enter mid-round or wait for the next deal. Consider adding data-testid on the disabled-state buttons too so testers can always assert their presence.

MyTable uses inline inline-style radial-gradient with hex → browsers serialize back to rgb(); if any downstream assertion checks the hex string it will fail (encountered this in this run). Non-blocking.
The header sequence in RummyTable (room-code + INFO + FULLSCREEN + Rewards) is dense on tablet widths; verify it still fits at 768px (not tested this pass — request was 1920).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable review bullets (rummy-discard/declare are code-conditional, not a regression)

test_credentials: player1@royal11.com / ChangeMe123! (as provided). Daily bonus for player1 shows 'Claimed today' + countdown — expected per request.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing player1 account; no server-side state was created (cosmetics live only in localStorage).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) The initial Splash overlay can intercept early clicks even after clicking 'Skip'; use JS click via page.evaluate() on the target testid, or remove splash nodes (querySelectorAll('[class*="splash" i]')) after the Skip click. 2) MyTable cosmetics keys in localStorage: 'royal11_cosmetics' (JSON {felt, picks}) and 'royal11_rummy_theme' ('red_felt'|'green_felt'|'luxury'). 3) React converts inline hex to rgb() when reading style attribute — assert on rgb triplets, not hex substrings. 4) On practice Points Rummy the bot auto-plays and pushes the round to SETTLED; the discard/declare buttons only render mid-round — either enter a new round or accept that these testids are conditionally mounted. 5) Cards nav item is exposed as data-testid 'side-nav-games' / 'nav-games' (labeled 'Games'), not 'cards'; the actual card-game category on /casino is reached by clicking the game toggle 'casino-game-rummy_points'.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Initial false-negatives on felt recolor & persistence assertions were entirely a test-harness bug (comparing to hex substrings while browser serialized inline styles to rgb()). Once corrected all recolor + persistence checks pass. Splash overlay intermittently intercepted mouse clicks; switched to JS-dispatched clicks and all interactions succeeded.
